subject: File control entry
notes: LANDED 2026-09-06 (kb/Work PB742). RULE (--check 12.4.5.2 9): "Format 2 shall be specified only for a relative file. The associated file description entry shall not be a sort-merge file description entry." SR8's twin one format over, landed in the same change set for the reason the register keeps re-learning: a rule set with one member enforced is the shape in which the missing member hides. Sentence 1 is a row over the RELATIVE KEY clause - 12.4.5.1 prints it in Format 2 and nowhere else - screened on every organization but relative; `ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL ... RELATIVE KEY IS R` compiled clean and bound a key no path read (measured). Sentence 2 is an Entry row over a sort-merge file description entry, reachable by the ORGANIZATION clause alone (SELECT ... ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE over an SD, with no key clause at all, is the pb742-relative-format-on-sort-merge-entry fixture) - COBOL1900. Boundary measured: the same clause on a RELATIVE file, and a legal Format-4 entry, draw nothing.
